description: Metaschema for label schemas. Labels are indexed key-value pairs attached to resources that can be used for querying and filtering. Labels whose `labelProperties.isAuthAttribute` is true are additionally materialized into the ReBAC attribute store by the resource controller.

labelProperties.description: ODF-specific metadata for this label schema.

isAuthAttribute.description: When true, this label is materialized into the ReBAC attribute store by the resource controller. Labels with this flag must appear under `labels`, not `annotations`, and will be validated as such.

isRequired.description: When true, this label must be present on all resources listed in `resourceTypes`.

resourceTypes.description: List of resource type URIs this label is valid for. When absent the label is allowed on any resource type.
